summary: Essex County lookout on West Pond Mountain: landowner-built tower 1915, CCC steel tower 1936, sold to a private owner in 1973; FFLA still lists it standing.

facts.design: Steel tower with stairs and glass-enclosed cab, erected 1936 by a CCC company to replace an older tower
facts.agency: Built 1915 by the Vermont Timberland Owners Association; state forestry agencies maintained it into the 1950s

access.note: Sold into private ownership in 1973 and not open to the public; the Forest Lookouts page quotes the owner's 2019 request that visitors respect their wishes.

events.note: Added as a lookout point, per a Vermont forestry history
Vermont Timberland Owners Association constructed a tower and station
121st Company CCC erected a steel tower with stairs and glass-enclosed cab to replace an old tower; new watchman's cabin built
Levi Pond completed his duties on the West Pond Mt. fire tower, per Essex County Herald notice (November 1950)
Sold into private ownership; not open to the public

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A state report of about 1924 lists West Pond among new steel towers, while the 1936 CCC report describes a steel tower replacing an older one; the sources do not say which steel tower is which, so the story gives both without choosing.

sources.title: West Pond Mountain (Forest Lookouts), quoting Vermont forestry reports and the Essex County Herald
Watching from above: The story of Vermont's fire towers

notes_for_editor: Everything before 1973 comes from a transcription of state reports and a 1950 newspaper notice on the Forest Lookouts page, not the originals. Current status rests only on the FFLA list. The sale to a private owner means no public access; the owner's 2019 email is quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, so treat that as the owner's stated wish. The 1915 tower's structure type is not given. Record location and county (Essex) match the FFLA list; no corrections proposed.
